rawFindings.title: Incorrect indentation offset for tokens after ignored binary/logical operator
rawFindings.explanation: The newly added line at line 1046 indiscriminately sets the desired offsets for tokens occurring after the token following a binary or logical operator to an offset of 1. This can cause incorrect indentation in all cases without special handling, as it overrides previous offset settings and applies a forced 1-level indent which can be incorrect.
rawFindings.suggestion: Remove the added line at line 1046 or revise it to correctly handle offsets without forcing a generic indent level. Ensure offset settings integrate correctly with existing logic to avoid indentation errors for tokens after binary/logical operators.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Binary or logical expressions where the right-hand expression starts on new lines following an operator will have their tokens after the operator indented incorrectly (1 indent level too much or ignored prior offset settings).
